sonnet.problem: The story card just before (card 7) says the LORD tells Abram to "look to the heavens." That rules out the wrong answers "sand," "flocks" and "tents" for the first blank, so "stars" is given away.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: Choice card 5 asks about Genesis 15:15-16 before story card 6 tells verse 15 and choice card 7 asks verse 16. The cards go to verses 15-16, then back to 15, then to 16, so they jump ahead of the passage order.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
